description: This file defines a PHP class `HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Legacy` which is part of the HTMLPurifier library. Its purpose is to implement a legacy module handling deprecated HTML elements for XHTML 1.1 compliance. The class contains methods to set up various deprecated HTML elements and their attributes for use in HTML purification.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Legacy
classes.description: A class extending HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule that implements legacy, deprecated HTML elements for XHTML 1.1 compliance, adding elements and attributes typical of older HTML versions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes legacy HTML elements like 'basefont', 'center', 'font', and others, setting their attributes and content models for HTML purification.
